Eligibility itself depends on g, so a guard computed on another setting's circuits is not sufficient. Return the exact peak for every setting and choose the smallest safe setting. If none is safe, return guard_ns=null; the well-defined infeasible outcome is part of the task, not an unsolvable submission."
